note: 构建期生成的采样报告。固定种子，同版本同输出。这是某次采样的结果，不是「模型真理」。
noteEn: A sampling report generated at build time. Fixed seed, same output for the same version. This is the result of one sampling run, not "model truth".

collapseGain.caveat: 该系数是编译期常量，本脚本无法从外部扫描不同取值。此处的胜率是「当前系数下」的实测值；契约 §9.1 的质疑（系数无独立实证依据）依然成立。
collapseGain.caveatEn: The coefficient is a compile-time constant; this script cannot scan other values from outside. The win rate here is measured under the current coefficient; the contract §9.1 objection (no independent empirical basis) still stands.

socialDemocracy.caveat: reformRoom 折减使该路径在 public_ownership ≥ 0.62 时失效——这不是采样噪声，是公式的必然结果。
socialDemocracy.caveatEn: The reformRoom discount disables this path at public_ownership ≥ 0.62 — this is not sampling noise but a necessary consequence of the formula.

chattering.caveat: 前馈模型无内生临界点，路径翻转只发生在两个人工闸门附近，因此抖动天然有限。
chattering.caveatEn: A feed-forward model has no endogenous tipping point; path flips only occur near the two artificial gates, so chattering is naturally bounded.

structurallyUnreachable.name: 商业资本主义
structurallyUnreachable.reason: stageOf 最低只返回 STAGE_BY_ID[1]（pen<0.38 → 算法资本主义），没有 stage 0 的返回分支。
structurallyUnreachable.reasonEn: stageOf only ever returns STAGE_BY_ID[1] at its lowest (pen<0.38 → algorithmic capitalism); there is no branch returning stage 0.

rareButReachable.name: 自由人联合体
rareButReachable.note: 需同时满足 pen≥0.68、communism 引力胜、soc≥0.72、abu≥0.78、meaning≥0.46。六剧本中「全域共享」可稳定到达；随机空间里极罕见（另一批 20000 组无种子采样中出现 4 组，约 0.02%；本固定种子批次为 0 组）。
rareButReachable.noteEn: Requires pen≥0.68, communism winning on gravity, soc≥0.72, abu≥0.78 and meaning≥0.46 simultaneously. The "universal commons" scenario reaches it reliably; in random space it is extremely rare (4 groups in a separate unseeded sample of 20000, about 0.02%; 0 groups in this fixed-seed batch).

start2024.caveat: 2024 年 u=0，所有杠杆取 NOW 基准值，因此首年渗透度与杠杆无关。这是插值起点的设计使然，不是 bug；但它意味着时间轴停在 2024 时显示的阶段恒为「极化资本主义」，而叙事上 2024 应是前史向算法资本主义的过渡。
start2024.caveatEn: In 2024, u=0, so all levers take their NOW baseline values and first-year penetration is independent of the levers. This follows from the interpolation start point and is not a bug; but it means that with the timeline parked at 2024 the stage shown is always "polarized capitalism", whereas narratively 2024 should be the transition from prehistory to algorithmic capitalism.

techOnlyBeforeGate.caveat: pen < GATE_PEN 时，固定渗透度扫遍制度/社会/意义全网格，阶段恒定不变——制度杠杆在岔路前不参与阶段判定。这是 P1-3 的核心，也是模型最该被质疑的简化之一。
techOnlyBeforeGate.caveatEn: When pen < GATE_PEN, sweeping the entire institutional/social/meaning grid at fixed penetration leaves the stage unchanged — institutional levers play no part in stage determination before the fork. This is the core of P1-3 and one of the most questionable simplifications in the model.
